$comment: Hinglish display names for the 29 curriculum sections, authored overlay for public/generated/curriculum/sections.json. WHY AN OVERLAY AND NOT THE GENERATED FILE: sections.json is extracted from the source PDF by tools/extract.mjs and then REPAIRED IN PLACE by learn.cjs -> stages.cjs -> guides.cjs -> packs.cjs (all four write it). `npm run stages` even prints 'input, transformed data, or output?'. Authoring a translation inside that file therefore survives exactly until the next extraction. This file is the single authored source for a section's Hinglish NAME, in the same spirit as content/curriculum/stage-overrides.json; the generated file stays the single source for its English content and its ids. Precedence: this map supplies the Hinglish side only. English is unchanged, ids are unchanged, and a section missing here simply shows its English title. Translated in batches: a title appears here only when it has been reviewed, never machine-generated.
